summary_note: No retrieved work combines controlled mutation of neuron models, multi-protocol electrophysiology fingerprints, refinement-calibrated tolerances, optimised compact protocol batteries, and held-out model / mutation-family evaluation (finite search; absence of evidence only). Closest partial overlaps: stimulus/protocol selection for constraining or discriminating models (Druckmann 2011; Patten-Elliott 2025; Lei 2023; Apgar 2008), mutant-killing input generation for Simulink models (Brillout 2010), near-silent conductance changes in AP models (Jaeger 2019), controlled channel perturbations across many conductance models (Koch 2023), and existing multi-protocol/tolerance testing infrastructure (OMV, NeuroML-DB, HippoUnit). OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar coverage is missing because of rate-limit blocks.

Differs from NeuroSem: goal is parameter constraint for model fitting against recordings, not detecting faults in edited models; no controlled mutants, tolerance calibration, or greedy compact battery evaluated on held-out models/mutation families.
